r0-context.title: Load baseline context
r0-context.imperative: Read your inherited global doctrine (this skill's references/global-crew.md and references/global-everyone.md), then the project deltas if present: docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, plus the handoff, the diff, and the relevant packet. Record pass when loaded.
r0-context.finding: Loaded handoff, implementer result, SKILL.md, curate_corpus.py source. docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md and GLOSSARY.md not present in this repo (degrades gracefully).

r1-handoff.title: Handoff compliance
r1-handoff.imperative: Did the change do what the handoff asked, within its allowed scope? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r1-handoff.finding: Handoff asked for skills/curator/SKILL.md (new) + one SKILL_NAMES line. Both present and match. See r4a-r4e for detailed per-criterion evidence.

r2-scope.title: Scope drift
r2-scope.imperative: Did the change stay inside allowed scope and respect specific exclusions? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r2-scope.finding: git status --short shows exactly: M tests/test_install_constellation.py, ?? skills/curator/. ls skills/curator/ = SKILL.md only. No install_constellation.py, no bundle, no other skill touched.

r3-evidence.title: Required evidence
r3-evidence.imperative: Is the required evidence present and does it actually demonstrate the behavior? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r3-evidence.finding: Reproduced all claimed evidence independently: dogfood grep, pytest full suite (446 passed/2 skipped), git diff of test file, ls of curator dir. All match implementer's report byte-for-byte.

r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet the inherited project/section rules (the handoff's constraints)? Append a check per rule. Record pass/fail with a finding.
r4-quality.finding: See appended r4a-r4e for the 5 close criteria, each verified independently.

r5-reconciliation.title: Reconciliation check
r5-reconciliation.imperative: Does the change diverge from the recorded architecture in a way Commander must reconcile? Record pass/fail; flag a triage candidate if it is out of scope.
r5-reconciliation.finding: No architecture divergence. Map Impact notes (struct/capability/constraint/decision/claims) match the diff: new skill dir is SKILL.md-only, invoker:human convention seeded as designed, no silent redesign. One corpus-wide observation (not a divergence introduced by this change): curate_corpus.py's own duplication check flags a 3-skill+ cluster (admiral,cartographer,charter,curator,implementer,interrogator,lessons-auditor,reviewer,scout,workbench) sharing the boilerplate line 'Compliance/engine-drive rule: inherited - see references/global-everyone.md.' This is the existing corpus convention curator's SKILL.md correctly follows, not a defect it introduced -- flagging as out-of-scope observation only.

r4a-frontmatter.title: Frontmatter check
r4a-frontmatter.imperative: name=constellation-curator; description third-person with when-to-use + exclusion naming scout and write-a-skill; invoker: human present.
r4a-frontmatter.finding: name: constellation-curator present. description is a single quoted scalar with zero person tokens (i/you/your/we/our/us) - verified by reading the words manually. Contains 'Use when a human runs a corpus-health pass' (when-to-use marker). Contains 'not architecture-map auditing (scout) or authoring a new skill (write-a-skill)' - names both scout and write-a-skill by name, matches EXCLUSION_MARKERS 'not '. invoker: human present.

r4b-dogfood.title: Dogfood check
r4b-dogfood.imperative: curate_corpus.py --root skills grep ^curator shows invoker=ok, when-to-use present (no flag), exclusion present (info), size within budget.
r4b-dogfood.finding: Reproduced: py scripts/curate_corpus.py --root skills | grep -i ^curator ->  curator description-exclusion info; curator invoker ok invoker=human; curator size ok body 40 lines/400 words within budget. No description-when-to-use flag row, no description-length flag row, no parse row. Exit code of full run = 0.

r4c-body.title: Body topic coverage
r4c-body.imperative: Body covers trigger/invariant1/invariant2/mend/route/outputs/portfolio-duty/error-modes correctly and without contradicting curate_corpus.py.
r4c-body.finding: Read SKILL.md body against curate_corpus.py source. All 8 topics present: Trigger (human-only, never scheduled/agent-dispatched/code-change-reaction), Invariant#1 (measure before mend, starts with curate_corpus.py, T7 mechanical/semantic split matches script docstring), Invariant#2 (flags-never-gates, exit 0, rows not failures - matches script's hardcoded return 0), Mend (in-place mechanical, git-diff review gate, fixed linear pass/no engine checklist), Route (design decisions -> Triage), Outputs (CURATOR_REPORT.md + --json, inline, no template), Portfolio duty (optional/dormant until #106, no dependency), Error modes (unparseable dir = row check=parse, first-run flags all invoker tags = expected). No contradictions found against script behavior.

r4d-boundary.title: Green-at-boundary
r4d-boundary.imperative: SKILL_NAMES gained exactly constellation-curator and nothing else changed; pytest tests/ -q is green.
r4d-boundary.finding: git diff tests/test_install_constellation.py shows exactly 1 insertion: +"constellation-curator", nothing else changed in that file. py -m pytest tests/ -q -> 446 passed, 2 skipped, 150 subtests passed.

r4e-scope-files.title: File scope
r4e-scope-files.imperative: Only skills/curator/SKILL.md and the one SKILL_NAMES line changed; no install_constellation.py edit, no bundle entries, no new curator install tests, no other skill touched, no report template shipped.
r4e-scope-files.finding: git status --short = M tests/test_install_constellation.py, ?? skills/curator/ only. ls skills/curator/ = SKILL.md only (no references/, no templates/). Confirmed no install_constellation.py, bundle, or other skill file changed.

consolidation.summary: All 5 close criteria verified with independently reproduced evidence: frontmatter correct, dogfood clean (invoker=ok, exclusion=info, size=ok, no length/when-to-use flags), body covers all 8 required topics without contradicting curate_corpus.py, SKILL_NAMES boundary edit is exactly 1 line and full suite is green (446 passed/2 skipped), and file scope is exactly skills/curator/SKILL.md + the one SKILL_NAMES line. No blockers.
